HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\ExampleUserApp
    DisplayName    REG_SZ    Example User App
    Publisher      REG_SZ    Example Software LLC
    InstallLocation    REG_EXPAND_SZ    %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Example User App
    UninstallString    REG_SZ    "%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Example User App\uninstall.exe" /uninstall

HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\HiddenUserHelper
    DisplayName    REG_SZ    Hidden User Helper
    Publisher      REG_SZ    Example Software LLC
    SystemComponent    REG_DWORD    0x1

HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\NoDisplayName
    Publisher      REG_SZ    Nameless Vendor
    InstallLocation    REG_SZ    C:\Users\Alice\AppData\Local\Nameless Vendor
